title: Class 3 Science Olympiad: 35-Question Pattern Mock
description: Practice the published 2026–27 section pattern: 5 Logical Reasoning, 25 Science and 5 Achievers questions, with Achievers carrying 2 marks each. Questions are Kidsplay-authored, not an official SOF paper.

selectionPolicy.notes: Operationalizes the official Level-I 60% current-class / 40% previous-class syllabus rule within the 25-question Science section. This is a delivery policy; it does not promote any row to official SOF provenance.
